decisions.english: linear algebra; linear equation; system of linear equations
decisions.decision: Retain the existing opening title provisionally. Equation and system are not present in this opening and should not be inserted solely for this audit. The future system phrase is a composition in Punjabi grammar, not an attested native specialist phrase.
decisions.definition_distinction: An equation is one equality, with variables occurring linearly; a system is a collection required to hold simultaneously. A linear system may have no solution, one solution or multiple solutions. Do not confuse linear equations with linear maps: a nonzero right-hand side need not describe a linear subspace.

decisions.decision: Retain transparent provisional borrowing and Punjabi inflections ویکٹراں and فضاواں. No native mathematical attestation or official Urdu attestation for the full vector-space phrase was established.
decisions.definition_distinction: An abstract vector is an element of a specified vector space over a specified field. A vector space has vector addition and scalar multiplication satisfying the axioms; it is not merely physical empty space or a list of arrows. A subspace uses the ambient operations and is closed under them, including the zero vector.

decisions.decision: Retain provisionally. Indexed Urdu bridge evidence supports the matrix borrowing only; it does not verify شناختی میٹرکس as a standard native Punjabi label.
decisions.definition_distinction: A matrix is a rectangular array of entries in indexed rows and columns. An identity matrix is square with diagonal ones and off-diagonal zeros; it must not be confused with the zero matrix. Its role is multiplicative identity, not merely identifying an object. Do not restrict general matrices to real entries because the Grade 9 bridge source does.

decisions.decision: Retain as an expressly provisional semantic extension; no native or official Urdu technical attestation established in this bounded search.
decisions.definition_distinction: A basis is a linearly independent spanning set. Ordinary foundation or merely a spanning set is not enough. When Hefferon uses an ordered basis for coordinates, preserve that order; a vector's coordinates depend on the chosen ordered basis.

decisions.decision: Retain provisionally, paired with its precise mathematical meaning in a clearly original glossary/clarification if the parent workflow adds one. Do not claim ordinary uses of spreading establish this technical sense.
decisions.definition_distinction: The span of a set is the set of all finite linear combinations of its vectors over the given scalar field, equivalently the smallest subspace containing it. It is not interval width, physical spread, the cardinality of the set, or just the listed vectors themselves.

decisions.definition_distinction: Real numbers include rational and irrational numbers. Real is a mathematical category, not a claim that complex numbers are unreal or invalid. Keep the source symbols and scalar-field context unchanged.

decisions.decision: Retain only as a transparent provisional label, not a certified conventional Punjabi equivalent. For a glossary or original clarification, make the English sense and a+bi definition explicit. This search did not verify a primary Urdu or native Punjabi printed occurrence establishing this exact mapping; do not replace it with another Urdu variant merely on presumed standardization.
decisions.definition_distinction: A complex number is a+bi with real a and b and i squared equal to -1. It is not a composite integer (an integer greater than 1 with a nontrivial factorization). The term مرکب can suggest compound/composite, so the two senses must not be collapsed.
